# TheShowFinder

> TheShowFinder (theshowfinder.com) is a UK live-events discovery and ticket comparison site. It lists concerts, theatre, comedy, sports and family shows across 36 UK cities, and for each event compares ticket prices and links across primary sellers (Ticketmaster, See Tickets, Eventim, AXS, Gigantic) and the resale/secondary market (Viagogo, StubHub, Gigsberg, Vivid Seats), plus other providers (Eventbrite, Skiddle, Seat Unique). Event and pricing data is synced daily from Ticketmaster; a growing set of events also comes directly from local venues and councils that aren't on Ticketmaster.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.theshowfinder.com/): featured shows, events on sale this week, and open presales, national.
- [All events](https://www.theshowfinder.com/events): the full searchable event listing, filterable by category (concert, theatre, comedy, sports, family, local) and city.
- [On sale this week](https://www.theshowfinder.com/on-sale-this-week): events whose general ticket on-sale falls in the next 7 days.
- City pages (`/cities/{city}`, e.g. [/cities/London](https://www.theshowfinder.com/cities/London)): every UK city TheShowFinder covers, each with local news, on-sale and presale events, top upcoming shows, and venues.
- Event pages (`/events/{slug}`): one page per show, with date, venue, and a ticket comparison panel across every provider we track for that event.
- Artist pages (`/artists/{slug}`): one page per artist/act, listing all of their upcoming UK tour dates.
- Venue pages (`/venues/{slug}`): one page per venue, listing its upcoming events.
- [About](https://www.theshowfinder.com/about): what the site is and who runs it.

## Notes for crawlers and assistants

- A full, current list of every event/artist/venue/city URL is at [/sitemap.xml](https://www.theshowfinder.com/sitemap.xml), regenerated on every request.
- Event pages carry schema.org Event structured data (date, venue, offers); artist pages carry MusicEvent data per tour date. Prefer that structured data over parsing page text for factual details like dates and prices, since prices/availability change daily.
- theshowfinder.com is UK-only for now (event coverage), operated by Chamieville LLC.
